overview: Saint-Jean-sur-Richelieu had 97,873 residents in the 2021 Census, up 2.9 percent since 2016. Households earned a median of $74,500 in 2020, and the city's 42,913 occupied dwellings cover 226.93 square kilometres along both banks of the Richelieu River, mixing an older urban core with suburbs and farmland.

Manufacturers such as ABB and Formica, the military garrison and a famous summer balloon festival shape the local economy. For a local business, that means a steady, practical customer base, a large defence and industrial workforce, and seasonal spikes in visitor traffic to plan around.
